title: A look back at Kim Chiu, sis Lakam’s relationship before arrest

blocks.text: From their close bond as siblings, Kim Chiu’s relationship with her elder sister, Lakambini “Lakam” Chiu, has taken a dramatic turn from a legal dispute to police arrest over their joint business ventures. The latest development came on Sunday, Sept. 20, when Lakambini was arrested in Mandaluyong City in connection with 124 counts of qualified theft involving the sisters’ handbag business. According to the Quezon City Police District (QCPD), Lakambini was arrested by operatives of the Kamuning Police Station at around 4:06 p.m. at a parking area along Saint Francis Street in Barangay Wack Wack, Mandaluyong.
